citations.snippet: In 1961, with the help from the Soviet Union, Vietnam commenced construction of Uong Bi thermal power plant - the main power source for the North. Besides, Ninh Binh Thermal Power Plant with a capacity of 100MW constructed with support from China had been put into operation since 1974. These are the first coal-fired power plants with a capacity of up to hundreds of MW which have been constructed by Vietnam.
citations.title: Overview of coal-fired thermal power development in Vietnam
